svg.title: A 7-year wisteria, 8373 commits, 10 ripening pods, 7 lanterns for code reviews.
svg.desc: A bonsai grown from the public GitHub history of maintainer, drawn for 2026-07-15. Drawn as a wisteria, which is a choice of the owner's. Season: summer. Maturity level 7 of 13, in a antique pot. Every element is recomputable from public history; nothing here is random or purchasable.
